identity.seoDescription: Data Engineer at Lowe's India. GCP · AWS · Azure · Spark · Databricks · Airflow · SQL. DP-203 certified. 529+ LeetCode problems solved.

hero.tagline: Data Engineer at Lowe's India building reliable batch & near-real-time pipelines across GCP, AWS and Azure — Spark, Databricks, Airflow, SQL and Delta Lake in production.

about.headline: Who is Shashwat Bangar?
about.body: Shashwat Bangar is a Data Engineer at Lowe's India in Bengaluru, focused on production pipelines, warehouse modeling and data quality across GCP, AWS and Azure. Before Lowe's he was a Data Engineer at Azira (location-intelligence / Near Intelligence), shipping Spark and SQL workloads for campaign and geospatial analytics. Earlier he built Ionic/JS retail apps at HotWax Commerce (BOPIS, Job Manager, threshold management) and completed CDAC ACTS '23. He is DP-203 certified, practices DSA publicly on LeetCode (529+ solved), and writes about PySpark patterns in the open.

items.title: Batch & Streaming Pipelines
items.blurb: Airflow-orchestrated Spark jobs with clear DDL/DML ownership
items.body: Designs thin orchestration layers on Airflow with versioned SQL (DDL/DML) and PySpark transforms — staging → dimensions/facts → DQ gates — the same pattern used in his Bing Ads warehouse challenge and production retail/campaign loads.

items.title: Lakehouse & Warehousing
items.blurb: Bronze/silver/gold on Delta, BigQuery and warehouse MySQL
items.body: Models lakehouse layers with Delta Lake (bronze ingestion, DQ reconciliation, gold serving) and cloud warehouses like BigQuery / MySQL — including near-real-time payments reconciliation with mismatch and missing-settlement tests.

items.title: Multi-Cloud Data Platforms
items.blurb: GCP · AWS · Azure paths with DP-203 depth on Azure
items.body: Moves data across object storage, compute VMs and warehouse services on GCP (GCS, Compute, BigQuery, Looker), AWS and Azure — DP-203 certified, comfortable choosing the right managed service vs Spark cluster for the SLA.

items.title: Analytics Engineering
items.blurb: Mage / Spark ETL into BI-ready models
items.body: Ships end-to-end analytics stacks — e.g. Uber TLC trips through Mage on GCP into BigQuery with Looker Studio dashboards, and Formula 1 Ergast data through Spark SQL + Tableau / Streamlit for forecasting visuals.

items.title: Data Quality & Observability
items.blurb: Structural tests, amount thresholds, mismatch alerts
items.body: Bakes DQ into the pipeline: structural tests on warehouse loads, amount-mismatch thresholds (e.g. ₹1+), missing settlement detection, and clear failure surfaces so bad data never silently lands in gold tables.

items.title: DSA for Data Engineers
items.blurb: 529+ LeetCode; hash maps & window patterns on the job
items.body: Treats algorithms as production tools — campaign→ID hash maps for fast lookups, sliding windows and SQL window functions for aggregates — with a public LeetCode grind (165 Easy · 323 Medium · 41 Hard) to keep the edge sharp.

items.summary: Building and operating retail data pipelines for Lowe's India — Spark/SQL transforms, cloud warehouse loads and DQ gates that keep merchandising and ops analytics trustworthy.
bullets: Own batch pipelines on Spark / Databricks with Airflow orchestration for retail analytics domains
Model staging → dim/fact loads with SQL DDL/DML versioned alongside DAGs
Partner with analytics and platform teams on GCP/AWS/Azure storage and warehouse patterns
Harden jobs with data-quality checks and clear failure alerting before gold promotion

items.summary: Data engineering for Azira's location-intelligence platform (Near Intelligence era) — campaign analytics, geospatial joins and Spark/SQL pipelines feeding marketer-facing products.
bullets: Built PySpark pipelines for campaign and location datasets with explicit Spark SQL functions (F.*) to avoid Python builtin collisions
Used hash-map style campaign→ID indexes for efficient multi-campaign fetches in large jobs
Delivered warehouse-ready transforms and DQ checks for marketing analytics consumers
Collaborated with product engineering on schema contracts and backfill strategy

items.summary: Frontend/Ionic work on HotWax omnichannel retail apps — Job Manager, threshold management and BOPIS — before transitioning fully into data engineering via CDAC.
bullets: Shipped features on HotWax Commerce Job Manager and threshold-management Ionic apps
Contributed to BOPIS (Buy Online Pickup In Store) client flows for retail operators
Worked in a product squad with API contracts against the HotWax OMS backend

items.summary: Internship building production Ionic/JS surfaces for omnichannel order management.
bullets: Implemented UI flows across Job Manager, threshold management and BOPIS apps
Learned retail OMS domain (ship-from-store, pre-order, pickup) in a live product codebase

items.title: Payments Reconciliation
items.tagline: Near-real-time UPI ledger reconciliation on PySpark + Delta Lake
items.body: Bronze → DQ → gold lakehouse for matched transactions, amount mismatches above ₹1 and missing settlements — runnable on Databricks Free Edition with structural tests.
bullets: Delta tables for bronze ingest, DQ reconciliation and gold reconciled transactions
Tests for matches, amount mismatches and missing settlements
Documented production path: Kafka streaming, Auto Loader, Great Expectations, OPTIMIZE
items.outcome: Assignment-grade lakehouse with clear DQ gates and a production hardening checklist.

items.title: Bing Ad Performance
items.tagline: Airflow-thin DAG + versioned SQL into a MySQL warehouse
items.body: Senior DE coding challenge: CSV → validate → staging → ordered DDL → DML → warehouse, with DQ checks and structural tests. Airflow only orchestrates; SQL owns transforms.
bullets: DAG radancy_bing_ad_performance with MySQL warehouse connection
Numbered sql/ddl and sql/dml files encoding dependency order
DQ notifications on mismatch / bad rows
items.outcome: Clean separation of orchestration vs transformation with testable warehouse loads.

items.title: Uber Data Analytics
items.tagline: TLC trips through Mage → GCS → BigQuery → Looker Studio
items.body: End-to-end Uber TLC analytics on GCP: Mage pipeline on a Compute instance, modeled facts/dims in BigQuery, dashboards in Looker Studio.
bullets: GCP Storage + Compute + BigQuery + Looker Studio stack
Mage.ai as the modern orchestration / ETL layer
Published Looker report for trip and fare exploration
items.outcome: Full cloud analytics path from raw TLC CSV to stakeholder BI.

items.title: Fast Lane Forecast
items.tagline: Formula 1 Ergast analytics on Spark + Tableau / Streamlit
items.body: Spark SQL over Ergast F1 history with Hadoop-friendly storage, ML exploration and a Streamlit site (fastlaneforecast.streamlit.app) plus Tableau visuals.
bullets: HDFS + Apache Spark + Spark SQL pipeline
ER-modeled Ergast schema for races, results and standings
Streamlit + Tableau presentation layer
items.outcome: Public F1 analytics demo spanning batch Spark to interactive forecast UI.
